notes.title: SKUF BACKROOMS is out now!
notes.content:
Hello, mates!

The moment we've been waiting for has arrived! SKUF BACKROOMS is available now! 🎉

We want to say a huge thank you to each and every one of you who added our game to your wishlist. Your support inspires us to move forward and create something special! ❤️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2911290/SKUF_BACKROOMS/

Thank you for sticking with us.
